stories.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong NL MVP Case — The Ohtani Factor, 34 Games Left
stories.angle: Pete Crow-Armstrong leads all of baseball in fWAR (7.7) — but Shohei Ohtani's surging candidacy is applying real pressure on PCA's MVP case. With 34 games left, PCA's historic defensive numbers (22 outs above average, 24 fielding run value in 1,055⅔ innings) give him a dimension Ohtani can't match — but voters historically favor traditional counting stats. PCA is hitting .281/.30HR/78RBI/31SB on a team in first place in the NL Wild Card race. The next 34 games may decide who wins the award.

stories.title: Joshua Baez — The Adjustment Period Arrives
stories.angle: Joshua Baez entered the MLB as a legend — 3 HRs in his first 3 career at-bats on August 15, the first player in MLB history to accomplish that. But one week in, MLB pitching staffs have started to figure out his approach. The adjustment game runs both directions, and now it's the rookie's turn to counter. K rate of 32.7% is an early concern. Cardinals deploying him in a lineup position that maximizes his impact while protecting him from the toughest matchups.

x_posts.text: Joshua Baez was the most electric MLB debut in recent memory — 3 HRs in first 3 at-bats. Now, one week in, pitchers are making their adjustment. Baez has a 32.7% K rate. The answer to whether he belongs will come in the next 30 days. #STLCards

stories.title: Yordan Alvarez Triple Crown Chase — Schwarber Leads HR by 1, 34 Games Left
stories.angle: Yordan Alvarez holds the best batting average in baseball (.329) and leads in RBI (88) but trails Schwarber by one home run (37-36). If Alvarez can close the HR gap while protecting his other leads, he would be the first Triple Crown winner since Miguel Cabrera in 2012. With 34 games remaining, the math is still viable — but every day the race tightens.

stories.title: NL Playoff Picture — Cubs 74-54 Lead the Wild Card

For the Cubs, the question is seeding: can they hold off the Phillies (70-58) and Padres (68-60) while maintaining the Wild Card No. 1 position that avoids a first-round matchup with Milwaukee? With 35 games left, avoiding the Brewers in a Wild Card Series starts with staying hot the rest of August.
